name: Photoreceptor / retinal pigment epithelium
failures: Inherited retinal dystrophy, macular degeneration, photoreceptor death. No human regeneration.

see.note: Adaptive-optics imaging resolves individual cones in a living eye.

model.note: Structure is well mapped; restoring degenerated architecture is not solved.

reach.note: Subretinal injection into a small, immune-privileged, enclosed compartment.

edit.note: Luxturna corrects RPE65 in one genotype; broader photoreceptor rescue remains unproven.

verify.note: Visual function and OCT structure both measurable.
